cohort: Sera were obtained from 105 healthy adult donors for Peripheral Blood Serum (PB-S) and from 107 umbilical/placental veins at the time of delivery for Cord Blood Serum (CB-S).
finding: EGF, TGF-a, TGF-b2, FGF, PDGF, VEGF, NGF, IL-1B, IL-4, IL-6, IL-10, and IL-13 levels were significantly higher in CB-S compared to PB-S, while IGF-1, IGF-2, and TGF-b1 levels were significantly higher in PB-S.
cross-section timing: Samples were collected at the time of delivery (for CB-S) and from healthy adult donors (for PB-S).
